activity: Source inspection only; no new tests, builds, benchmark measurements, or implementation edits in this review. Documentation updates were separately authorized.
conclusion: No new engine-correctness defect identified in the bounded inspected paths. One repository-confinement finding was fixed by the primary agent; final gate validation remains separate.

checks.conclusion: The binder validates columns/types/group legality before row loops. NULL validity precedes payload arithmetic. Both execution paths apply result/group caps and preserve the documented evaluation domain before LIMIT. Numeric faults in typed vectors are consumed in row order; simultaneous independent NUMERIC diagnostics and memory-budget outcomes retain their documented limits.

Hash keys reject any NULL component; build match vectors retain every duplicate. The cursor advances one probe match offset and resumes it across bounded batches without materializing a joined table. Stable source provenance directs payload reads.

Only successfully evaluated literal trees fold. Pushdown requires a total entire WHERE before splitting AND terms. Pruning visits select/where/join/pushed/group dependencies. Build swaps are guarded for DOUBLE SUM/AVG and fallible expressions; smaller-side selection uses base cardinality with right-side ties.

The plan retains its AST resource owner and weak catalog identity. Execute rejects moved-from/foreign/replaced handles before borrowed-column use. Successful catalog publication changes identity; failed loads do not. Every Runtime resets binding read counters and descriptor pointers and creates fresh views; result storage remains owned independently.

DuckDB tables are created with explicit types and inserted from logical fixture values; Quarry is invoked as an independent native process. Canonical SQL/typed-data hashes exclude seed/configuration labels, deduplicate repeated empty fixtures, and are checked against per-build success receipts. The precise pinned optimizer guard executes unchanged SQL; no result post-sort hides discrepancies.

Both resident and prepared validation emit complete typed results. Timed trials share algorithms/storage/right build/owning sink, use fresh execute state and seeded schedule, and exclude digest/render/output/destruction from execution while reporting rendering separately. Python validates before timing, checks matching verified Release/source fingerprints, preserves raw records, and regenerates medians/IQR/paired ratios. Review is bounded and does not establish performance results.

findings.finding: Native mutation fuzz fixtures and retained failures originally used system temp rather than Quarry build storage.
findings.disposition: Primary agent replaced the system-temp root with QUARRY_FUZZ_ARTIFACT_DIR supplied as CMAKE_BINARY_DIR/fuzz. Read inspection confirms the local-root definition and use; final gates will rebuild and verify it.
findings.status: implementation corrected; final dynamic verification pending

findings.finding: Pinned DuckDB compressed_materialization reversed two UTF-8 string keys on the recorded host.
findings.disposition: Disable only that oracle optimizer; preserve identical SQL and require the hand-expected ASC/DESC ordering. Raw default behavior remains diagnostic rather than a required cross-platform failure.
findings.status: corrected; targeted regression observed in evidence/m7-python-targeted-gate.json

limitations: Finite source review is not exhaustive semantic verification.
PMR injection covers accounted allocations on selected paths, not global/runtime allocations.
Deterministic mutation fuzzing is bounded and is not coverage-guided.
Final Debug/Release/sanitizer, clean-install, benchmark, and remote-CI acceptance must be read from primary-agent evidence; this review makes no new pass claim for them.
IQR overlap is descriptive and not a significance test; timing cannot establish SIMD/cache mechanisms or eliminate external machine noise.
